slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Told you have osteoarthritis in your knee or hip, and now worried about exercising?

Current guidelines put exercise at the front of the queue for knee and hip osteoarthritis. Strengthening the muscles around the joint can help ease stiffness and keep you doing what you enjoy.

Clinical Pilates is a comfortable way in for many people. Reformer springs can support you at first, many exercises start lying or sitting, and the load builds gradually. A mild ache that settles within a day is usually fine. Much worse the next morning means scale back, not stop.

A hot, very swollen joint, or one that locks or gives way, is worth getting checked. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio tailors every program. Book online via the link in bio.
